name: brainwsp-platform
description: BrainWSP - WhatsApp Gateway, live inbox and agent platform for BrainPOS/ERP integrations

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n API,WORKER,WEB -c auto "npm run dev -w @brainwsp/api" "npm run dev -w @brainwsp/worker" "npm run dev -w @brainwsp/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @brainwsp/api && npm run build -w @brainwsp/worker && npm run build -w @brainwsp/web
